document.abstract: In the Scandinavian countries no fundamental or systematic research on acoustics in movie theaters has been done, as far as I know, and, as a non-authority in the field, I am able to give only a brief informal report of some facts about our theaters and what I think is the general opinion on theater design at the moment in Scandinavia.
